name: Raphael
source:
"He told us to hate everyone."

He has taken it upon himself to punish or judge others; the dark side of the benevolent God.

He loved God so much that when God disappeared, he thought it was because of all beings apart from those in Heaven and came to hate everything.

He is always destroying, ripping, or punishing something. Most of the time, his entire body is drenched in blood, which is why they also call him the Red Angel.
